claim: Required Compact diagnostics. Parallel raw-growth timings and instrumented retention are separate from complete-engine performance and final acceptance.

conversion.measured_interval: One raw insert, including COW detachment when pinned, control reindex/widening, key hashing and row growth; incoming key/value allocation and complete checks outside measurement.
conversion.comparison: Matched raw always-wide controls; results cannot be treated as full Store/feed or network latency.

retention.memory: Tracked owned payload bytes/value instances only; RSS includes fixture and instrumentation. Exact old payloads and release after all owners drop are required.

inputs: Only development inputs. Final holdout seeds remain untouched.
